```markdown # TITLE LINUX SECURITY HANDBOOK # SUBTITLE FROM LINUX HARDENING TO PRODUCTION SECURITY # BADGES PAGE 16 OF 20 # SECTION_HEADINGS - PAGE 16: FILE INTEGRITY AND PERSISTENCE DETECTION - KEY TOPICS - FILE HASHES WITH SHA256SUM - FILE INTEGRITY MONITORING - PERSISTENCE LOCATIONS - CRITICAL SYSTEM FILES TO MONITOR - DETECTING UNAUTHORIZED CHANGES # BODY_PARAGRAPHS (No standalone body paragraphs outside of lists/tables) # IMPORTANT_FILES | File Path | Description | |-----------|-------------| | /etc/passwd | Critical system file to monitor | | /etc/shadow | Critical system file to monitor | | /etc/sudoers | Critical system file to monitor | | /etc/ssh/sshd_config | Critical system file to monitor | | /bin, /sbin, /usr/bin, /usr/sbin | Critical system directories to monitor | | /etc/systemd/system/ | Critical system directory to monitor | | /boot/ | Critical system directory to monitor | | /var/spool/cron/ | Cron persistence location to monitor | | /root/.bashrc, /root/.ssh/ | Shell startup files to monitor | # TABLES ## Key Topics Table | Topic | Description | |-------|-------------| | CRITICAL SYSTEM FILES | (Listed in Important Files section) | | UNEXPECTED FILE MODIFICATIONS | (Described in Detecting Unauthorized Changes) | | FILE HASHES | Using SHA256SUM for verification | | SHA256SUM | Command-line tool for hashing | | FILE INTEGRITY MONITORING | Regularly hash critical files and compare | | CRON PERSISTENCE | Check for malicious cron jobs | | SYSTEMD PERSISTENCE | Check for unknown systemd services | | SHELL STARTUP FILES | Check for suspicious commands in startup scripts | | SUSPICIOUS BINARIES | Track new or modified binaries | | DETECTING UNAUTHORIZED CHANGES | Monitor and alert on unexpected changes | ## Persistence Locations Table | Type | Location | Commands to Check | |------|----------|-------------------| | **CRON PERSISTENCE** | Check for malicious or unexpected cron jobs. | `crontab -l`
`ls -la /etc/cron.*`
`ls -la /var/spool/cron/` | | **SYSTEMD PERSISTENCE** | Malicious or unknown systemd services. | `systemctl list-unit-files --type=service`
`ls -la /etc/systemd/system/` | | **SHELL STARTUP FILES** | Check for suspicious commands in startup scripts. | `cat ~/.bashrc`
`cat ~/.bash_profile`
`ls -la /etc/profile.d/` | ## File Integrity Monitoring Table | Action | Details | |--------|---------| | Regularly hash critical files. | Use sha256sum on important files | | Store hashes securely. | Keep hash lists in safe location | | Compare hashes to detect changes. | Use `-c` flag with sha256sum | | Use tools like AIDE, Tripwire, or OSSEC. | Advanced monitoring solutions | ## Detecting Unauthorized Changes Table | Action | Details | |--------|---------| | Monitor critical files and directories. | Focus on system binaries and configs | | Track new or modified binaries. | Watch /bin, /sbin, /usr/bin, /usr/sbin | | Review file ownership and permissions. | Check for unauthorized permission changes | | Alert on unexpected changes. | Set up automated notifications | | Investigate immediately. | Respond promptly to alerts | # COMMANDS | Command | Description | Example | |---------|-------------|---------| | `sha256sum` | Generate SHA256 hash for a file | `sha256sum /etc/passwd` | | `sha256sum -r` | Generate SHA256 hash for a directory (recursive) | `sha256sum -r /etc > etc.sha256` | | `sha256sum -c` | Verify against known good hash list | `sha256sum -c etc.sha256` | | `crontab -l` | List current user's crontab | `crontab -l` | | `ls -la /etc/cron.*` | List cron configuration files | `ls -la /etc/cron.*` | | `ls -la /var/spool/cron/` | List system-wide cron jobs | `ls -la /var/spool/cron/` | | `systemctl list-unit-files --type=service` | List all systemd service units | `systemctl list-unit-files --type=service` | | `ls -la /etc/systemd/system/` | List custom systemd unit files | `ls -la /etc/systemd/system/` | | `cat ~/.bashrc` | Display current user's bashrc | `cat ~/.bashrc` | | `cat ~/.bash_profile` | Display current user's bash profile | `cat ~/.bash_profile` | | `ls -la /etc/profile.d/` | List system-wide profile scripts | `ls -la /etc/profile.d/` | # TIPS_NOTES_WARNINGS **TIP BOX:** PROTECT. MONITOR. VERIFY. INTEGRITY TODAY, SECURITY FOREVER. **WARNING ICON (Detecting Unauthorized Changes section):** ⚠️ Monitor critical files and directories. Track new or modified binaries. Review file ownership and permissions. Alert on unexpected changes. Investigate immediately. # PRACTICAL_EXERCISES (No explicit numbered practical exercise steps shown on this page) # FOOTER_TEXT VERIQTA YouTube @veriqta | GitHub @veriqta | LinkedIn @veriqta | X @veriqta | Instagram @veriqta | Telegram @veriqta # PAGE_NUMBER 16 OF 20 ```
